content: cf_clearance cookie is bound to IP + User-Agent + TLS/JA3 fingerprint used during the solve. The SAME User-Agent must accompany every subsequent request or a new challenge/block fires. Validity typically 30-60 min (configurable up to 24h via Challenge Passage); Precursor may re-evaluate mid-session. Reusing with mismatched fingerprint => immediate block. Confirms ROADMAP criterion 4 UA-binding requirement.
